title: accumarray
summary: Accumulate values into an array by subscript groups.

gpu_support.notes: Grouped accumulation runs on the host.

description: `accumarray(subs,data)` groups entries of `data` by one-based subscripts in `subs` and sums each group into the corresponding output element.
behaviors: Supports vector, matrix, and cell-vector subscripts.
Supports scalar expansion of numeric/logical data, explicit output sizes, common callbacks such as `@mean`, general function-handle callbacks, fill values, and 2-D sparse numeric output.
